title: The Customs Fee in Coins
intro: A text says a parcel with your hardware wallet is stuck at customs.
You did order a wallet last week. It might be real.

notify.text: Your parcel is held. Pay a clearance fee…

screen.context: You did order a hardware wallet last week from the maker's own shop.

msg.text: held for an unpaid import fee
Parcels are returned or destroyed in

fee.label: A fee in USDT
fee.lens: Customs charges are paid through official channels, never in crypto.
fee.why: Crypto payments cannot be reversed. That is why scammers want them.

addr.label: A personal wallet address
addr.lens: A raw address instead of an official payment page.
addr.why: Real agencies never ask for a transfer to a private wallet.

held.label: Vague "held" notice
held.lens: It gives no tracking number, no shop and no document.
held.why: Real notices carry details you can match to your order.

timer.label: Returned or destroyed
timer.why: Pressure stops you from checking the shop.

proof.label: Send a screenshot
proof.lens: They want proof so they can take the next payment.
proof.why: This is a sign of a scripted scam.

actions.label: Check the order and tracking in the maker's own shop
Delete it and report the text as junk

trap.title: Customs Clearance
trap.ask: Send 48 USDT to 0x91c…ab7 and send the screenshot.

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your phone company can block more of these texts.

verify.line: The shop's tracking showed the parcel on a normal delivery, with no fee. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. Reporting would help protect others.

go_ahead.line: The 48 USDT went to the scammer. The parcel arrived normally two days later, with no fee at all.

what_if.go_ahead: The shop tracking would have shown a normal delivery. Real fees are never paid in USDT.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting helps others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A quick report protects others.

golden_rule: If anyone asks for a fee in crypto, it is a scam. Check your order with the shop yourself.

quick_check.q: A text from "customs" asks for a clearance fee paid in USDT to a wallet address. What do you do?

options.text: Do not pay. Check the order with the shop and report the text

quick_check.explain: Official fees are never paid in crypto to a private wallet.

hints.nudge: How does the text want to be paid?

kit.label: Check payment
kit.title: How it wants to be paid

rows.v: Paid through official channels, never crypto
With the shop or the courier yourself
